heroHeadline: Syria–Hezbollah Contact Reported as Blasts Rock Idlib Airfield
heroSubtitle: Reuters-sourced reports on October 1 said Syrian officials held first face-to-face talks with Hezbollah in Turkey, which both Ankara and Damascus deny. On October 2, two large explosions of unclear cause hit near Taftanaz military airfield in Idlib, days after President al-Sharaa told the UN General Assembly that Israel must withdraw from the Golan.
